info.name: Lokal — Customer Mobile Journey
info.description:
End-to-end Postman collection covering the customer-facing mobile journey of the Lokal marketplace app, built from Local-App.pdf (design source of truth) and local-be's real endpoints (no global route prefix — every path is exact).

Folders are ordered to match the app's actual screen flow: Auth (OTP) → Home browse → Products → Wishlist → Cart → Addresses → Checkout & Payment → My Orders → Reviews → Refunds → Profile & Account → Notifications → FAQ / Support → Logout.

**Auth model**: Customer auth is OTP-only (phone + code), no password — see `POST /mobile/auth/send-otp` and `/verify-otp`. This collection uses collection-level Bearer auth wired to `{{accessToken}}`; `Verify OTP` auto-populates it via a test script, and every subsequent authenticated request inherits it automatically. Public/unauthenticated requests explicitly override auth to "No Auth".

**Known backend gaps** (see local-be CLAUDE.md): there is no dedicated home/trending endpoint — the Home screen is composed client-side from Banners + Categories + Vendors + `GET /products?sort=popular`; there is no public "Contact Us"/support-info read (Settings support fields are admin-only via `/admin/settings`); `PUT /users/change-password` will always 401 for OTP-only customer accounts since they never have a password hash (kept here for completeness/documentation).

**Running end-to-end**: Use Postman's Collection Runner top-to-bottom after setting `baseUrl` (default `http://localhost:3001`) and a real `phone`. Most list/create requests auto-capture IDs (`categoryId`, `vendorId`, `productId`, `addressId`, `cartItemId`, `orderId`, etc.) into collection variables for the next request to reuse — check each request's Tests tab. `Send OTP` only returns the `otp` field directly in non-production environments; otherwise retrieve it from the configured SMS provider or DB and set the `otp` variable manually before running `Verify OTP`.

variable.description: local-be has no global prefix. Nest dev server default is port 3000 (see local-be CLAUDE.md 'Commands'), but many local setups run PORT=3001 (matching the dashboard's VITE_API_BASE_URL default) — adjust to match your running instance.

E.164 format, must match /^\+[1-9]\d{6,14}$/. Must NOT match local-be .env ADMIN_PHONE (or any seeded vendor phone) — MobileAuthService.assertMobileAccessible() rejects send-otp with 403 FORBIDDEN for any existing non-customer account (vendor/admin must use the dashboard password login instead). Any unused number auto-creates a new customer account on first verify-otp.
MyFatoorah's own paymentId query param, only known once the hosted payment page redirects back — set manually if testing the callback route directly.

A real order with status=delivered — required for Submit Review / Request Refund, which are both gated on delivery server-side. Set manually (no self-serve way to reach "delivered" from the customer API alone).

item.name: 1. Onboarding & Auth
item.description: Screens: Language Select (frontend-only, no backend call) → Welcome back / Login (phone) → Verify Code (OTP). OTP-only auth for the 'customer' role — POST /mobile/auth/verify-otp creates the account on first use and logs in on every use after (see MobileAuthResponseDto.isNewUser).

request.description: Rate-limited 5/hour per IP. Response's `otp` field is only present in dev/staging (SendOtpResponseDto) — captured automatically below when present.
Rate-limited 10/15min per IP. Creates the account on first verify (isNewUser=true), logs in thereafter. Captures accessToken/refreshToken/userId for every subsequent request in this collection.

item.name: Get Current User (Profile header / session check)

request.description: Returns the full User domain object — used to populate the Profile screen header (name, email, avatar) and any session-restore check on app launch.
Called silently by the client when the access token expires.

item.name: 2. Home / Browse
item.description: Screen: Home. No dedicated /home endpoint exists — the client composes this screen from three public calls: Special Offers banners, Categories/Brands, and Shop by Stores. 'Best Seller Product' on Home and the Trending tab both use GET /products?sort=popular.

request.description: Active promotional banners for the Home carousel and the "Special Offers" (View All) screen.
Backs the Home "Categories and Brands" rail and the "Shop by Categories" screen (tabs are Category.department: men/women/kids/unisex).
Public, active-only vendor listing for the Home "Shop by Stores" rail. Supports `search`.

item.name: 3. Products — Trending, Filter, Search & Details
item.description: Screens: Trending Product, Filter modal, Shop by Categories result list, Store Details product grid, Search, Product Details, Product reviews shown on the PDP.

request.description: Trending tab / Home 'Best Seller Product'. Bearer token optional (OptionalJwtAuthGuard) — include it to get `isWishlisted` per item; omit for a pure guest browse.
Maps to the Filter bottom sheet: Categories, Colors, Gender checkboxes + Sort by.

item.name: List Products — By Category (Shop by Categories result)

request.description: Tapping a category card (e.g. "Fashion") on the Shop by Categories screen.

item.name: List Products — By Store (Store Details grid)

request.description: Product grid on the Store Details screen (below the "Follow Store" button).
Search screen — search bar submit (recent searches like "Cashmere Scarves" are client-stored, no dedicated backend endpoint).
Store Details screen header (logo, "Verified Artisan" badge, description, Follow Store).
Product Details screen — images, price, size/color pickers, description. Bearer optional for isWishlisted (heart icon state).
Approved-only reviews + rating breakdown for the product page.

item.name: 4. Wishlist
item.description: Screens: heart icon on any product card (PDP, Trending, Best Seller) + the dedicated 'My Wishlist' screen. Customer-only.

request.description: Toggle-add — tapping the heart icon on a product card or the PDP.
The "My Wishlist" grid screen.
Toggle-remove.

item.name: 5. Cart
item.description: Screens: 'Add to Cart' on PDP → Cart screen (line items, qty steppers, delivery address/payment summary, Order Info). Customer-only.

item.name: Add Item to Cart (PDP — Add to Cart)

request.description: Merges into an existing line with the same productId+size+color instead of duplicating (server-side).

exec: const item = json.cart.items.find(i => i.productId === pm.collectionVariables.get("productId")) || json.cart.items[json.cart.items.length - 1];

request.description: Shows line items, computed subtotal/deliveryFee/total (never persisted, recomputed on every read).
Not a single visible button in the PDF flow, but available — e.g. after a failed/abandoned checkout reset.

item.name: 6. Addresses
item.description: Screens: Cart 'Delivery Address' row → Address / Add Address form → Profile → Saved Addresses (list, edit, delete). Customer-only.

request.description: Matches the Address / Add Address form fields exactly (Name, Country, City, Phone Number, Address, "Save as primary address" toggle).
Profile → Saved Addresses screen, and the address picker on the Cart screen.
Selecting the checkmark next to an address on the Cart screen.

item.name: 7. Checkout & Payment
item.description: Screens: Cart 'Payment Method' row → Payment (saved cards) / Add New Card → Checkout button → hosted MyFatoorah payment page (external, opened via paymentUrl) → Order Confirmed. An Order is only ever created server-side AFTER MyFatoorah confirms payment — POST /orders itself does not create one yet.

request.description: Prices every available method against the current cart total. 422 CART_EMPTY if the cart is empty — add an item first (see folder 5).
Tokenized MyFatoorah embedded session — backs the "Add New Card" screen and returns any previously saved cards.

Exactly one of paymentMethodId (from Get Payment Methods) or sessionId (from Create Payment Session, for a tokenized/saved card) is required. Re-validates and re-prices every cart item server-side, then calls MyFatoorah ExecutePayment. Open the returned paymentUrl in a webview to complete payment.
Alternative to the paymentMethodId variant above — use when paying with a tokenized/saved card session instead of picking a method fresh.

Hit by the browser/webview redirect after a successful MyFatoorah payment, NOT called directly by the app — included for backend testing only. Re-verifies with MyFatoorah's GetPaymentStatus before creating any Order (never trusts the redirect alone). Requires a real `myFatoorahPaymentId` from an in-progress checkout session to return anything meaningful.

Identical handler to the success callback — included for completeness. If payment is not actually confirmed, the CheckoutSession is marked failed and no Order is created; the cart is left untouched for retry.

item.name: 8. My Orders
item.description: Screens: My Order (Active / Previous / Canceled tabs) → Order card (Invoice / Track Order) → Order Tracking timeline. Customer-only, read-only status (only the vendor advances in_transit/delivered).

request.description: Not delivered/cancelled — matches statuses shown as "In Transit" / "Picked" on the Active tab.
Delivered orders.
Order Tracking screen — statusHistory drives the timeline (Order Confirmed / Preparing / Pick Up / Delivered), driver contact card.
"Invoice" link on an order card.
Allowed only while status is 'placed' or 'confirmed' (service-enforced).

item.name: 9. Reviews
item.description: Post-delivery flow — not a distinct screen in the PDF excerpt, but the real backend action behind a product's rating (PDP shows aggregate). Requires a genuinely delivered order.

request.description: orderId + productId together must prove a real delivered purchase (service-enforced) — set {{deliveredOrderId}} to an order with status=delivered before running. Starts as pending until admin-moderated.

item.name: 10. Refunds
item.description: Customer-initiated refund request against a delivered order — not shown as its own screen in the PDF excerpt but a real backend flow reachable from an order (e.g. a "Request Refund" action on My Orders).

request.description: Only a delivered order is eligible (service-enforced); one request per order (unique index on orderId). refundAmount is capped at the order total server-side.

item.name: 11. Profile & Account
item.description: Screens: Profile (name/email header, Edit) and its settings rows. Note is the current user's profile — see 'Get Current User' in folder 1 for the read side.

request.description: Profile screen Edit action.

Note: the Profile screen's 'Notification' toggle in the PDF maps conceptually to notificationsEnabled, but that specific field is set via PATCH /me/settings/notifications per the notifications module, not this endpoint — see next request.

exec: console.log("FCM token registered — check GET /mobile/auth/me for the tokenId to remove it later.");

request.description: Set {{fcmTokenId}} from the fcmTokens array on the User object (GET /mobile/auth/me) first.

Included for completeness only. OTP-only customer accounts never have a passwordHash, so this always 401s (UNAUTHORIZED, 'Current password is incorrect') for the customer role — it's effectively a dashboard (vendor/admin) route despite sharing the /users path prefix.

exec: pm.test("Customer account has no password — expect 401", function () {

request.description: password is only checked if the account has a passwordHash — never true for OTP-only customers, so effectively optional here. Destructive — do not run against a real account casually.

item.name: 12. Notifications
item.description: Shared collection across customer/vendor/admin (no @Roles restriction, just JwtAuthGuard) — order_update pushes land here for customers (checkout confirmation, vendor status change, cancellation).

item.name: 13. FAQ & Support
item.description: Screens: Profile → FAQ, Profile → Contact Us. FAQ is a real public endpoint; Contact Us has NO backend endpoint today — local-be's settings module (support email/phone/whatsapp/website/office address) is admin-only (/admin/settings), not exposed to the mobile app. Flagged as a backend gap in local-be's own CLAUDE.md.

request.description: Active-only FAQs for the customer app (distinct from /admin/faqs used by the dashboard).
Omit refreshToken in the body to revoke all sessions for this user instead of just the current one.
